---
format:
  typst: default
---

```{=typst}
#let navy = rgb("#1E2B55")
#let charcoal = rgb("#20262D")
#let slate = rgb("#596673")
#let mist = rgb("#D9DEE2")
#let sail = rgb("#F4F5F6")
#let pcss-gold = rgb("#F4C91D")

#set page(
  paper: "us-letter",
  margin: (top: 0.28in, bottom: 0.42in, x: 0.44in),
  footer: context [
    #set text(
      font: ("Arial", "Liberation Sans", "DejaVu Sans"),
      size: 6.4pt,
      fill: slate,
      hyphenate: false,
    )
    #grid(
      columns: (1fr, auto),
      column-gutter: 10pt,
      [Technology Commons - Weekly Progress + Learning Skills],
      [Page #counter(page).display("1 of 1", both: true)]
    )
  ]
)

#set text(
  font: ("Arial", "Liberation Sans", "DejaVu Sans"),
  size: 10pt,
  fill: charcoal,
  hyphenate: false,
)
#set par(leading: 0.46em, justify: false)

#let write-line() = line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.7pt + slate)
#let check-box() = rect(width: 9pt, height: 9pt, stroke: 0.9pt + navy, radius: 1pt)

#let brand-header(title, subtitle) = [
  #grid(
    columns: (1fr, 2.35in),
    column-gutter: 18pt,
    align: top,
    [
      #text(size: 22pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[#title]
      #v(1pt)
      #text(size: 10.2pt, weight: "bold", fill: slate)[#subtitle]
    ],
    [
      #grid(
        columns: (0.52in, 1fr),
        column-gutter: 8pt,
        align: horizon,
        [#image("technology-department-emblem.svg", width: 0.48in)],
        [
          #text(size: 8.2pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Technology Commons]
          #linebreak()
          #text(size: 7.4pt, fill: slate)[Port Credit Secondary School]
        ],
      )
    ],
  )
  #v(4pt)
  #line(length: 0.66in, stroke: 3pt + pcss-gold)
  #v(2pt)
  #line(length: 100%, stroke: 1.2pt + navy)
]

#let eval-item(label) = [
  #grid(
    columns: (1fr, auto),
    column-gutter: 5pt,
    align: horizon,
    [#text(size: 8.4pt, weight: "bold", fill: charcoal)[#label]],
    [#check-box()]
  )
]

#let daily-box(day) = block(
  width: 100%,
  height: 1.70in,
  stroke: 0.8pt + mist,
  radius: 4pt,
  inset: (x: 8pt, y: 7pt),
)[
  #grid(
    columns: (1fr, 1.26in),
    column-gutter: 10pt,
    align: top,
    [
      #text(size: 12.4pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[#day]
      #v(3pt)
      #grid(columns: (auto, 1fr), column-gutter: 5pt, align: horizon,
        [#text(size: 9.6pt, weight: "bold")[Today's goal (specific):]],
        [#write-line()]
      )
      #v(6pt)
      #grid(columns: (auto, 1fr), column-gutter: 5pt, align: horizon,
        [#text(size: 9.6pt, weight: "bold")[How will I know I met it?]],
        [#write-line()]
      )
      #v(6pt)
      #grid(columns: (auto, 1fr), column-gutter: 5pt, align: horizon,
        [#text(size: 9.6pt, weight: "bold")[Who did I work with?]],
        [#write-line()]
      )
      #v(6pt)
      #text(size: 9.6pt, weight: "bold")[What did I accomplish or learn today?]
      #v(4pt)
      #write-line()
      #v(8pt)
      #write-line()
    ],
    [
      #block(
        height: 100%,
        fill: sail,
        stroke: 0.6pt + mist,
        radius: 3pt,
        inset: (x: 7pt, y: 7pt),
      )[
        #text(size: 9pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Evaluation]
        #v(6pt)
        #eval-item([Neat])
        #v(7pt)
        #eval-item([Detailed])
        #v(7pt)
        #eval-item([Technical terms])
        #v(7pt)
        #eval-item([Level 1-4])
      ]
    ]
  )
]

#brand-header([Weekly Progress Log], [Set the Goal. Follow the Way. Take Action.])
#v(5pt)
#grid(
  columns: (auto, 1.25fr, auto, 0.82fr, auto, 1fr),
  column-gutter: 5pt,
  align: horizon,
  [#text(weight: "bold")[Name:]], [#write-line()],
  [#text(weight: "bold")[Course:]], [#write-line()],
  [#text(weight: "bold")[Week of:]], [#write-line()],
)
#v(7pt)
#text(size: 15pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Daily Progress]
#v(2pt)
#line(length: 100%, stroke: 2pt + pcss-gold)
#v(5pt)

#daily-box([Monday])
#v(4pt)
#daily-box([Tuesday])
#v(4pt)
#daily-box([Wednesday])
#v(4pt)
#daily-box([Thursday])
#v(4pt)
#daily-box([Friday])

#pagebreak()

#let rating-panel() = [
  #block(
    height: 100%,
    fill: sail,
    stroke: 0.6pt + mist,
    radius: 3pt,
    inset: (x: 7pt, y: 7pt),
  )[
    #text(size: 8pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[SELF-RATING]
    #v(5pt)
    #grid(columns: (auto, auto), column-gutter: 5pt, row-gutter: 6pt,
      [#text(size: 8.4pt, weight: "bold")[E]], [#check-box()],
      [#text(size: 8.4pt, weight: "bold")[G]], [#check-box()],
      [#text(size: 8.4pt, weight: "bold")[S]], [#check-box()],
      [#text(size: 8.4pt, weight: "bold")[N]], [#check-box()],
    )
  ]
]

#let skill-row(title, prompt) = block(
  width: 100%,
  height: 1.28in,
  stroke: 0.8pt + mist,
  radius: 4pt,
  inset: (x: 8pt, y: 7pt),
)[
  #grid(
    columns: (1fr, 0.88in),
    column-gutter: 10pt,
    align: top,
    [
      #text(size: 11.5pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[#title]
      #v(1pt)
      #text(size: 8.8pt, fill: slate)[#prompt]
      #v(5pt)
      #write-line()
      #v(8pt)
      #write-line()
      #v(8pt)
      #write-line()
    ],
    [#rating-panel()]
  )
]

#brand-header([Learning Skills Reflection], [How have I demonstrated and improved these learning skills?])
#v(5pt)
#grid(
  columns: (auto, 1.18fr, auto, 0.86fr, auto, 0.9fr),
  column-gutter: 5pt,
  align: horizon,
  [#text(weight: "bold")[Name:]], [#write-line()],
  [#text(weight: "bold")[Course:]], [#write-line()],
  [#text(weight: "bold")[Week of:]], [#write-line()],
)
#v(5pt)
#text(size: 8.2pt, fill: slate)[E = Excellent   G = Good   S = Satisfactory   N = Needs Improvement]
#v(7pt)

#skill-row([Responsibility], [Getting things done without reminders, using class time well, and following through on tasks.])
#v(4pt)
#skill-row([Organization], [Keeping track of goals, tools, materials, files, and time in an effective way.])
#v(4pt)
#skill-row([Independent Work], [Starting promptly, staying focused, using available resources, and solving problems before asking for help.])
#v(4pt)
#skill-row([Initiative], [Doing what needs to be done, asking thoughtful questions, seeking feedback, and acting on next steps.])
#v(4pt)
#skill-row([Collaboration], [Working well with others, listening, sharing tools and space, and helping the group succeed.])
#v(4pt)
#skill-row([Self-Regulation], [Managing distractions, staying balanced and safe, responding to feedback, and adjusting when something is not working.])
```
